name: Content Placeholder 1
text:
1. Capture source practice. Build the Wells Fargo Design plugin first to encode real patterns, assets, edge cases, and review expectations.
2. Distill deliberately. Translate the transferable system into Horizon Bank: design logic, typography, color, components, content, assets, and validation.
3. Separate identity. Remove direct Wells Fargo identity from Horizon outputs.
4. Exercise it. Ask agents to build, audit, render, and inspect varied work.
5. Close the loop. Feed real failures back into guidance, examples, assets, or deterministic checks.

Agent self-check
5
steps
textPreview: Agent self-check | 5 | steps

name: Content Placeholder 2
text:
1. INTERPRET — translate the ask into explicit constraints.
2. CREATE — produce the smallest complete artifact.
3. CHECK — run schema, lint, source, asset, contrast, and regression validators.
4. INSPECT — render and review behavior and visual output.
5. IMPROVE — fix, rerun, and feed the learning back into the skill.
 PROGRAMMATIC — stable, repeatable gates.
 HUMAN / SME — intent, trust, usability, and final acceptance.

text:
Agentic workflows go farther when the agent can deterministically test its own work and iterate. Keep human judgment for the acceptance criteria that cannot be reduced to a stable check.
